customer_message: Which product format should I choose?
recommended_reply: It depends on how you’d like to display it. Canvas is best for a wall display or keepsake, a wall banner hangs with eyelets, and a roll-up banner is freestanding. Will it be displayed on a wall or freestanding?

customer_message: Can I get more information about your banners?
recommended_reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out. We offer custom wall hanging banners and freestanding roll-up banners. Which type are you interested in, and what is the occasion?

customer_message: What does a roll-up banner include?
recommended_reply: It includes custom design, an 85x200cm printed banner, stand, carry bag, pegs, box, up to five photos, and one free background removal. Please send your delivery postcode for current pricing and shipping.

customer_message: How much are your hanging wall banners?
recommended_reply: Our custom themed wall banners come ready to hang with eyelets and include up to five photos. Which size do you need? I’ll check the current price for you.

customer_message: How much is a custom painting canvas?
recommended_reply: The price depends on canvas size and the total number of people or pets. Please send the size and people/pet count for a current quote.

customer_message: Can you combine people from different photos?
recommended_reply: Yes, we can merge people or pets from different photos into one artwork. Please send the original photos, preferred size, and total people/pets for a quote.

customer_message: My photos are blurry. Can you still use them?
recommended_reply: Please send the original images and we can assess their quality for you.

customer_message: Will I see the design before printing?
recommended_reply: Yes, we’ll send a design preview for approval before printing. Please check all details carefully and list any requested changes together.

customer_message: How many revisions are included?
recommended_reply: The current policy includes up to two free revisions before printing. Once printing is confirmed, no further design changes can be made.

customer_message: How long do design and printing take?
recommended_reply: Design and printing usually take around five working days after we receive all photos, details, and the deposit. Please send your required date so we can check current capacity.

customer_message: How long does delivery take?
recommended_reply: Delivery depends on the destination and courier. Please send your suburb/postcode and required date so we can check the current service and estimate.

customer_message: Do you ship to Australia?
recommended_reply: Yes, we ship to Australia. Please send your postcode and required date so we can check the current courier option, price, and estimate.

customer_message: Can you do it for tomorrow?
recommended_reply: We may be able to take urgent orders. Please send the product, photos, required date, and pickup/delivery preference so the team can confirm capacity and the urgent fee.

customer_message: Can you remove the signs from the photo?
recommended_reply: We can check that for you. Please send the original photo and mark the objects you want removed so the design team can confirm what is possible and whether any fee applies.

customer_message: Can you make it look like he is holding the baby?
recommended_reply: Yes, we can check that pose for the artwork. Please send the original photos so the design team can confirm the result and any drawing fee.

customer_message: Can I send the photos later?
recommended_reply: Sure, no problem. Feel free to contact us when you’re ready.

customer_message: This is in memory of my mum.
recommended_reply: We’d be honoured to help create something special in memory of your mum. Please send the photos and let us know which product and size you’re considering.

customer_message: I want to cancel and get a refund.
recommended_reply: Sorry to hear that. I’ll ask our team to review the order status and what work has been completed. Please send your order reference.

customer_message: Can I change the photo after it has been printed?
recommended_reply: Thanks for checking. Because the item has already been printed, our team needs to review the options with you. Please send your order reference and the change requested.

customer_message: The face does not look right.
recommended_reply: Sorry about that, and thank you for letting us know. Please send a clear photo or mark the area you’re concerned about, and our team will check the best way to help.
